title: Auto, taxi drivers to protest at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan today over fare revision, EV policy, bike-taxi services

ai.summary: Auto and taxi drivers in Delhi plan to protest at Ramlila Maidan today over fare revision, EV policy, and bike-taxi services, organised by the Bharatiya Private Transport Mazdoor Mahasangh.

facts.claim: Auto, taxi drivers to protest at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan today over fare revision, EV policy, bike-taxi services
facts.quote: Auto, taxi drivers to protest at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan today over fare revision, EV policy, bike-taxi services

facts.claim: The demonstration, organised by the Bharatiya Private Transport Mazdoor Mahasangh, which is affiliated with the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh, will begin at 11 am
facts.quote: The demonstration, organised by the Bharatiya Private Transport Mazdoor Mahasangh, which is affiliated with the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh, will begin at 11 am

facts.claim: Transport workers from across India are set to gather at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan on November 19, to protest against government policies and seek action on their long-pending demands
facts.quote: Transport workers from across India are set to gather at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan on November 19, to protest against government policies and seek action on their long-pending demands

facts.claim: The protest will bring together drivers of autos, taxis, buses, trucks, ambulances and e-rickshaws
facts.quote: The protest will bring together drivers of autos, taxis, buses, trucks, ambulances and e-rickshaws

facts.claim: The union said hundreds of workers were expected to participate and raise issues they believe have not been addressed by the central government, state governments and the Delhi government
facts.quote: The union said hundreds of workers were expected to participate and raise issues they believe have not been addressed by the central government, state governments and the Delhi government

facts.claim: The organisation has described the policies of these governments as “wrong policies”
facts.quote: The organisation has described the policies of these governments as “wrong policies”

facts.claim: Yogesh Sharma, national president of the Bharatiya Private Transport Mazdoor Mahasangh, and former general secretary Rajendra Soni alleged that governments had failed to deliver on commitments made to transport workers after assuming office
facts.quote: Yogesh Sharma, national president of the Bharatiya Private Transport Mazdoor Mahasangh, and former general secretary Rajendra Soni alleged that governments had failed to deliver on commitments made to transport workers after assuming office

facts.claim: They said the BJP government had been in power in Delhi for over a year and a half but had yet to fulfil any of the promises made to auto and taxi drivers
facts.quote: They said the BJP government had been in power in Delhi for over a year and a half but had yet to fulfil any of the promises made to auto and taxi drivers

facts.claim: They also alleged that fresh rules introduced by the central, state and Delhi governments were making working conditions more difficult for transport workers
facts.quote: They also alleged that fresh rules introduced by the central, state and Delhi governments were making working conditions more difficult for transport workers

ai.background_note: The protest is part of ongoing transport workers' demands for fare revision, EV policy changes, and closure of bike-taxi apps, organised by the Bharatiya Private Transport Mazdoor Mahasangh.
